primary_estimand: Design-weighted confirmed residual translation-defect rate in the frozen, uniquely production-resolved eligible P2 revision frame.
inference_scope: The canonical production-commit frame defined by this snapshot, item-level prior-experiment exclusions and three provenance strata only.
next_gate: Complete post-run JSON, diff, frozen-hash and executor-baseline validation, then commit SCORES.json, RESULT.json and all retry artifacts without changing the frozen source/reference interpretation.
stopping_rule: No reviewer inference until the committed package reports preflight GO. Invalid transport, parser, explicit tool-use or schema outcomes receive no score and are never converted to negative predictions. Reference-only scores must never be merged into the primary verified route ranking.
